items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: another fella got killed, John something clown that, he plays clown that, he got killed, yeah, in California.

ctx.x: Took men out of Sydney's band? Who's Sydney? Sydney Desby.

I see. Yeah, I believe he took one of the, Herbert Hall out of that band, a saxophone player. And, uh, he had a band, well, he can, he can hear you going all around. Well, he came to me, and, uh, told me about the deal. Well, I was kind of a little sick then, and my wife then was working as a waitress at the Pelican, and I was working up there on that story. And, uh, I had an offer to Sydney Desby to go on the boat, see. The season on the boat opens up around, I think around about April and May. So, I thought…
